Side-view survival-management game in a soft painterly storybook style: an enormous moss-covered stone-blue giant walking through a sea of cumulus clouds under a bright early-summer sky, seen from the side, head bowed with a calm closed-eyed face and a mossy mane, one arm hanging into the clouds. Along the curve of its back sits a tiny village of stepped terrace fields in green rice, golden barley and pink-white buckwheat, stone retaining walls, small cream houses with red roofs, chimney smoke, a turning water wheel and tiny villagers. Blue water channels trickle down the terraces toward the shoulder because the back tilts forward; soil crumbs slide off the tail end. One terrace is outlined with a dashed highlight and a parchment tooltip '7번 계단'. Distant rain curtain on the horizon, another tiny giant silhouette far away. Pastel blues, moss green, warm cream, gentle grain.
